description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An ally in range would die

Traits Signal, auditory

The triggering ally does not die. They are instead reduced to 0 Hit Points, fall unconscious, and are stable, with no dying condition. This works against any cause of death, including death effects and effects that would reduce them to 0 Hit Points and kill them outright. Their wounded value increases by 1 as normal. It does not work if their body is destroyed rather than killed.

cinderfall.incomplete: No death-prevention/death-interception rule element exists in the 34-key inventory (P12) — pf2e's own dying/wounded system is adjusted via `ActiveEffectLike` on fixed numeric fields (e.g., dying max), not via a "prevent this specific death" hook, and this is additionally a cross-creature trigger (bucket 4).
